data.value:
Welcome to Challenge 2. For this challenge, you are not assumed to have any previous knowledge of logic gates, but are expected to understand how basic boolean values work.
For this challenge, upon pressing "Start", you will be given a question and an assortment of logic gates. In order to score points, you must connect these logic gates in the correct order to give the correct output.
To move logic gates, hold right click on any gate and move it onto the main area (the one containing the signal generator and output display). To connect objects, left click on the object on which you want the connection to start, and then on the object on which you want the connection to end; this will be the direction logic "flows", as indicated by the arrow on the connection.
Once you are satisfied with your set-up, press C and your circuit will be executed with a "true" signal coming from the signal generator, which will flow through each logic gate until it reaches the output display.
If you obtain the correct output, you will be given a score of 4 for a "golden" attempt amount, 3 for "silver", 2 for "bronze", and 1 for any other. Furthermore, your score will be multiplied depending on the difficulty of the question; by 2 for medium, 3 for hard and 4 for very hard. If you get a question wrong, your attempts increase by one.
If you find a question too difficult, do not hesitate to skip.
A minimum number of connections required to solve each question has been predetermined, thus you must ensure that you use every gate in your question else you will not meet this minimum.
